title_en: In the Courtroom (4/20): The Broken Washing Machine
note_en: This text is full of 被 passives: 这个案子后来被当地媒体报道 "the case was later reported by local media." Unlike English, where the passive is neutral, 被 traditionally carries a sense that something was done to the subject, and the agent (当地媒体) sits right after 被, before the verb. Compare the 把 sentence 消费者把洗衣机带到法庭, where the doer comes first and 把 moves the object in front of the verb.
